name: ToolsConnector Actions
author: DeskStride
description: Execute actions from 77+ SaaS connectors (Gmail, Slack, GitHub, Stripe, Notion, Google Workspace, 14 AWS services, and more) via ToolsConnector's unified Python API. One generic node covers the entire 1,578+ action catalog with per-service API keys stored in extension settings. See README for connector list and credential setup.
